A food item which restores {{Energy||25 -}} {{Energy||35}} and applies the hard worker buff when consumed. It must be made in the [[oven]] and higher quality versions of the dish have a larger restorative effect. For the main page on preparing food see [[cooking]].

==Effect==

On use, lasagna will apply the hard worker buff for a duration of 2 minutes, reducing the amount of energy spent when working with axes or pickaxes.
